bagPolicy.summary: Luggage larger than 40 x 30 x 20 cm is not permitted. All visitors agree to entry security checks and baggage inspection, and an event organizer may impose stricter restrictions.
prohibited: luggage larger than 40 x 30 x 20 cm
bagPolicy.note: Organizer-specific restrictions can be stricter than the venue rules.

parking.note: Parking information is not explicitly provided on the Forum Karlín website. Visitors are advised to check nearby public parking facilities or use public transportation for convenience.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Forum Karlín's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Forum Karlín varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Forum Karlín is accessible to visitors with reduced mobility. The first floor includes reserved places, and other arrangements may be prepared by written agreement with the organizer.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A ticket allows one entry. Re-entry is only possible if it has been agreed in advance in writing with the event organizer.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Forum Karlín. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Forum Karlín. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
